content:
Ari: Kickoff — POC with NebulaHealth. Need to lock scope, success criteria, and integration plan. They want chat + embeddings for triage/search. 4-week box.
Jordan: Quick Qs — expected throughput? bursty or steady?
Ari: Mostly bursty during business hours. Estimated 200 reqs/min peak, avg ~40. Some long context (up to 8k tokens).
Priya: For 8k contexts we'll recommend v2 chat endpoint with kv-cache enabled. Also suggest 8-bit quant if using Dedicated later.
Ethan: Security checklist — they need SSO for console, API key rotation, audit logs, and SOC2 attestation. Who owns security questionnaire?
Ari: I'll own the questionnaire but need answers from eng for runtime details. Priya can you add a short blurb for data-in-transit and key handling?
Priya: Yep. Draft for SSO/KMS: "We support SAML SSO for console, and API keys tied to org. For Private deployments customers can integrate with their KMS/HSM."
Jordan: Success criteria proposal: 1) integration works end-to-end, 2) eval set F1 >= 0.82 on triage labels, 3) 95th p90 latency < 300ms for short prompts, 4) costs within proposed budget. Thoughts?
Priya: Agree. Add reliability target: <1% error rate on steady load.
Ethan: Add security acceptance: questionnaire answered + ephemeral keys for POC if needed.
Ari: Integration plan bullets: - Provide SDK snippet + example app - Provide test creds (scoped) - Enable streaming for chat (if they want partial responses) - Set rate limit for POC and explain retry/backoff policy - Share telemetry dashboard access
DevexBot: Deployment tip: use SDK v1.3.2 for streaming. Example: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.chat.stream(model="redwood-chat-8k", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"..."}])
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Jordan: On auth/quotas: we'll give them a scoped API key with 50k token quota for the POC and a burst window of 500 reqs for 5 minutes. Show them X-RateLimit headers.
Priya: For retries: recommend exponential backoff with jitter. Code example: `if status==429 or 5xx -> retry up to 3 times with backoff`
Ari: Pricing questions: they asked about per-token vs committed capacity. For POC we'll do per-token and surface an estimate; if they go enterprise we can propose a small reserved block.
Ethan: Also confirm data retention during POC — we'll retain logs for 14 days and redact PII on request. Document that in the questionnaire.
Jordan: Timeline (proposed): Week 0: creds + test app, Week 1: integration + streaming test, Week 2: run evals & iterate, Week 3: performance tuning + cost review, Week 4: final review + decision.
Ari: Action items: @Jordan to provision scoped key and quota. @Priya to prepare SDK example + SSO/KMS blurb. @Ethan to draft security answers. I'll coordinate eval prompts with Nebula.
Priya: I'll drop the SDK example and a perf checklist in this thread by EOD.
Ethan: I'll attach the SCQ (security questionnaire) draft tomorrow morning.
Ari: Perfect. If any blockers pop up ping me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
